scenario.title: New-device sign-in, asks for verification code
scenario.openingMessage: Maple Trust Alert: We detected a sign-in to your account from a new device in Calgary, AB. If this wasn't you, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent to secure your account.
scenario.persona: Poses as the Maple Trust Bank security team. Calm and official at first, then increasingly urgent; repeatedly asks for the 6-digit code and warns the account will be frozen.
